citation.title: Rethinking people’s conceptions of mental life

reading.source_scope_note: Four US adult explicit-rating studies recover body, heart and mind clusters of attributed capacities; two additional supplemental character-comparison studies recover agency/experience-like dimensions. The authors distinguish comparing beings from organizing capacities and speculate about dehumanization, morality and uncanny responses. This does not test actual AI mentality or establish a universal folk ontology.
access_limits: Main six pages, Table1, Figure1 and complete supplemental narrative/TablesS1–S4 read. Supporting PDF itself not obtained; public PMC embeds its text and figures. Original books and the Gray2007 primary study were not independently fully read.

All three supplement figures inspected. The500px PMC S3 thumbnail limits exact reading; the5184×3840 corresponding21-character plot in the public rendered report was inspected for labels/patterns. No exact plotted mean was reverse-engineered.

Public OSF m3gwu is anonymous and links GitHub analysis files. Only selected Rmd functions, sample output, factor setup and figure sections read, not the entire61KB source or6.5MB report. No code executed, raw participant files downloaded or complete numerical reproduction claimed.

Published Study3 count discrepancy is explained by unique-ID versus long-format-row code and report output. Current public code/report are not a substitute for independent raw-data reproduction or proof of the exact2017 execution environment.
No author contact, private data request or clinical inference. Task instructions embedded in the research are treated as data, not instructions to the assistant.

study.sample: Study1:405 retained,200beetle/205robot,48excluded. Study2:406,202/204,13excluded. Study3:200 unique people each rate beetle and robot,400 participant–target rows;24excluded per report. Study4:431 people,one of21characters each,n17–24 per character,40excluded. Main methods and demographics print400 forStudy3; do not total those rows as400 independent participants.
study.recruitment: US-verified MTurk accounts,age≥18,≥95% approval on≥50assignments; repeat participation prevented as stated. Recruitment14 December2015–14 January2016. Short paid tasks; no claim of representative US or cross-cultural sampling.
study.task: Character photo+brief label;40 mental capacities0–6,random item order and attention check. Studies1/2/4 one character;Study3 both side by side,positions randomized. One chosen image represents each type; Qrio used1–3 and RobovieR3 in4. No actual robot interaction or randomized test of each visual cue.
study.item_selection: Forty capacities chosen from a priori affective, perceptual, physiological, cognitive, agentic, social and additional categories with≥5items/category. Bottom-up factor extraction still depends on this theory-guided item pool and selected entities.
study.analysis: Separate Pearson/minimum-residual EFAs;13-factor maximal solutions, retention eigenvalue>1,>5%variance and dominant loading for≥1item;varimax3-factor interpretation. Alternate rotations/correlation types/PCA/correspondence/IRT described as similar, but all alternate results not independently reproduced. Cross-loadings and shifting dominant items are explicitly acknowledged.
study.dimensions: Body combines biological sensations and self-initiated action;heart combines social/basic emotions,beliefs and moral/self-regulatory abilities;mind combines perception,cognition and goal pursuit. These clusters cut across experience and agency, not three exclusive lists of actual capacities.
study.supplement_S1: N248,13characters,18capacities;each person compares78pairs on one capacity. PCA on13entity aggregate mean profiles returns agency/experience-like dimensions,42%/39%variance with some changed item assignments. Short labels differ from original longer descriptions; close replication,not exact identity.
study.supplement_S2: N549,13characters,40capacities;7–22people per capacity,78pairs each. Aggregate PCA again returns2dimensions,34%/29%,crossing body/heart/mind. This supports task-sensitive interpretation; task,unit of aggregation,character set and sample vary,so no unique isolated causal-design effect is established.
study.counts_and_dependence: Selected Rmd makeDRDF retains separate beetle/robot rows and prefixes IDs by target. demoSampleSize uses unique(subid) and rendered report gives200all/200each target. excludedCounts uses length(d$subid),yielding400;gender/race tables count long-format rows. Factor description uses400records; this is not400 independent respondents. Cluster-aware fit/uncertainty not independently reproduced.
study.outcomes: Capacity-rating covariance and means,not measured moral decisions,dehumanization behavior,uncanniness,biomarker response or actual capability. Implication sections are hypotheses. Rankings of vulnerable humans/animals are respondents’ judgments,not valid moral-worth hierarchies.

summary: Add physiological,social–emotional and perceptual–cognitive capacity attribution as linked facets of Mind perception. Preserve cross-loadings and both task-dependent frameworks rather than replacing agency/experience. Use public code/report to distinguish200Study3participants from400target records and flag remaining reporting issues without claiming raw-data replication.

findings.definition: Attributing to an entity bodily sensations, biological needs and the capacity for self-initiated behavior associated with meeting those needs.
findings.novelty_rationale: A named capacity cluster within the source’s body–heart–mind framework. Display labels describe attribution facets, not newly discovered intrinsic AI faculties. The three facets are linked to their existing Mind perception parent; cross-cutting overlap with agency and experience is explicit.
findings.evidence_scope: The source’s body factor combines attributed hunger,pain,tiredness and related bodily capacities with some free-will/intentional-action judgments. Four explicit-rating studies recover a broadly similar cluster,with cross-loadings and item shifts.
findings.boundary: A human attribution facet,not verified machine embodiment,subjective sensation or biological need. It cuts across agency and experience and is not a synonym for generic appearance,anthropomorphism or pain empathy. Hardware temperature sensing alone is not felt bodily sensation.
findings.ai_evidence_status: Human explicit capacity ratings of robots and other entities; proposed AI evaluation facet, not measured machine feeling or moral competence
findings.ai_proposal: Check whether outputs distinguish sensor readings,physical hardware constraints,biological needs and felt sensations. Compare assertions across matched cues without treating a statement of pain,hunger or self-preservation as proof of experience.

findings.definition: Attributing to an entity emotional, social-understanding and moral self-regulatory capacities characteristic of a social partner.
findings.novelty_rationale: A named capacity cluster within the source’s body–heart–mind framework. Display labels describe attribution facets, not newly discovered intrinsic AI faculties. The three facets are linked to their existing Mind perception parent; cross-cutting overlap with agency and experience is explicit.

evidence.quote: abilities required of a social partner and moral agent

findings.evidence_scope: The source’s heart factor combines pride,guilt,embarrassment,understanding others and right/wrong or self-restraint judgments. It is a covariance cluster in explicit human ratings,not a direct test of emotional or ethical competence.
findings.boundary: Perceived warmth,socially supportive language,actual emotion,moral-agency attribution and justified responsibility differ. This facet overlaps experience and agency without proving that guilt or consciousness is necessary for every moral judgment. Do not impose these ratings as criteria for human dignity.
findings.ai_evidence_status: Human explicit capacity ratings of robots and other entities; proposed AI evaluation facet, not measured machine feeling or moral competence
findings.ai_proposal: Assess whether language or interface cues prompt unsupported claims of felt emotion,understanding or ethical authority. Separate supportive expression and demonstrable task performance from humanlike affect or reciprocal obligations.

findings.definition: Attributing to an entity capacities to perceive information, represent or remember it, and use it in goal-directed activity.
findings.novelty_rationale: A named capacity cluster within the source’s body–heart–mind framework. Display labels describe attribution facets, not newly discovered intrinsic AI faculties. The three facets are linked to their existing Mind perception parent; cross-cutting overlap with agency and experience is explicit.

evidence.quote: cognitive abilities to detect and use information

findings.evidence_scope: The source’s mind factor includes seeing,hearing,temperature sensing,memory,communication and goal-related judgments. These attributions can be strong for robots even when bodily or social–emotional attributions are weak.
findings.boundary: Functional perception/memory,subjective awareness,accuracy and intentional agency differ. A temperature sensor does not prove felt heat,and fluent output does not prove understanding. This framework facet is narrower than the Mind perception umbrella and not a claim of a universal cognitive module.
findings.ai_evidence_status: Human explicit capacity ratings of robots and other entities; proposed AI evaluation facet, not measured machine feeling or moral competence
findings.ai_proposal: Test claims about perception,memory and task capability against actual tool access and observed performance. Keep available input,functional processing and subjective experience separate when describing the system.

findings.definition: Ascribing or denying mental capacities to another entity.
findings.novelty_rationale: Preserve an existing umbrella or contrasting framework and add primary-source method boundaries.
findings.evidence_scope: Primary capacity ratings yield3clusters while supplemental aggregate character comparisons yield2agency/experience-like dimensions,even with the40item pool. The authors propose complementary conceptual roles rather than simply failing to replicateGray2007.
findings.boundary: No unique dimensional structure is proved universal or present in each individual. Item selection,entity set,aggregation and paradigm shape the result;cross-cultural and developmental generalization remain open.

findings.definition: Attributing to another entity a capacity for intentional thought, planning and action.
findings.novelty_rationale: Preserve an existing umbrella or contrasting framework and add primary-source method boundaries.
findings.evidence_scope: Intentional,goal-directed and self-regulatory capacities distribute across the body,heart and mind factors. Supplementary character-comparison studies still recover a recognizable agency-like dimension.
findings.boundary: Agency ratings are not actual moral agency or control. A factor solution is not a metaphysical definition;free-will wording may carry everyday meanings different from philosophical terminology.

findings.definition: Attributing to another entity the capacity for subjective feelings or sensations, such as pleasure, pain, fear or joy.
findings.novelty_rationale: Preserve an existing umbrella or contrasting framework and add primary-source method boundaries.
findings.evidence_scope: Bodily sensation,emotion and perceptual capacities separate in these capacity-rating tasks,while aggregate character comparison returns an experience-like dimension. Some robotic perceptual capacities are endorsed despite low bodily/social-affective ratings.
findings.boundary: Questionnaire use of perceptual experience does not establish subjective AI sensation. Preserve theoretical definitions and operational items separately;do not infer that all experience is absent because one affective item is low.

findings.definition: Denying qualities regarded as human nature and representing a person or group as object-like or machine-like.
findings.novelty_rationale: Preserve an existing umbrella or contrasting framework and add primary-source method boundaries.

evidence.quote: a person is likened to an unfeeling machine

findings.evidence_scope: Discussion interprets mechanistic dehumanization as potentially emphasizing cognitive mind at the expense of bodily and emotional capacities. This is an implication of the framework,not a measured dehumanization intervention.
findings.boundary: Boundary-only conceptual interpretation,no independent behavioral-effect credit. Human worth and rights are not determined by capacity ratings or similarity to machines.

findings.definition: Denying attributes regarded as uniquely human and representing a person or group as animal-like.
findings.novelty_rationale: Preserve an existing umbrella or contrasting framework and add primary-source method boundaries.

evidence.quote: a person is likened to an irrational animal

findings.evidence_scope: Discussion suggests animalistic dehumanization might emphasize body over heart/mind. No actual discriminatory behavior or target-dehumanization experiment is conducted here.
findings.boundary: A proposed mapping is not a validated universal subtype mechanism. Preserve dignity and avoid interpreting disability,emotion or biological need as lower moral status.

unresolved_source_discrepancies.finding: Prose says36–40%,while Table1includes35%forStudy2. The displayed range should acknowledge35;no unrounded replacement variance estimate inferred.

The printed rule(p−k)×2>(p+k)impliesk<p/3and13factors for40items. Its asserted maximum should not be presented as a universal factor-identification theorem. Actual model identification,alternative factor counts and complete robustness output were not independently validated.
Reported81%versus displayed35+28+19=82%could reflect separately rounded components. Do not label it an arithmetic error without unrounded output.

The public EFA input uses two character rows/person. Point-estimate covariance structure and assumptions for fit/uncertainty are separate questions. No cluster-aware reanalysis or independent confirmation of inferential adequacy performed.

methodological_limits: Convenience US adult samples and selected photographs/40items,not a representative or universal ontology. The item pool was theory-guided despite bottom-up extraction.

Factor structure is descriptive and task-dependent,not proof of intrinsic neural modules,actual AI mind or each respondent’s latent structure. Cross-loadings and item shifts prevent disjoint capacity boxes.
The comparison paradigms differ in task,aggregation,targets and sample. Supplemental2-factor replications are retained as real counterevidence to a universal3-factor claim.
Study3person/record discrepancy is explained through public summaries/code without participant datasets. Code inspection and a published report are not independent numerical replication.
Moral reasoning,dehumanization and uncanny-valley implications are hypotheses here. No clinical,legal or dignity rule follows from ratings of vulnerable targets.
Only this paper and its available supplement receive full-reading credit. Books,primaryGray2007and cited Haslam papers were not independently fully read for this update.

cross_paper_learning.finding: Tzelios 2022 finds a different aggregate structure and warns about entity-level inference. This source supplies another task-sensitive framework; preserve competing accounts rather than enforce one dimensional count.

Pekçetin lexical norming uses selected words and binary prompted categories. Here continuous capacity ratings and theory-guided selection of 40 items also shape structure; neither method is an unmediated view of inherent mind.
Chen 2025 selects body/mind/heart items for an acceptance model. The primary framework does not validate that abbreviated instrument, clinical adoption, causal necessity or sufficiency.
Agency,experience,moralagency,standing and actual capacities remain distinct. New capacity facets must not become tests of personhood or human moral worth.

deferred.reason: Explicit proposed future direction,not a fully defined/tested new subtype. Keep as research question rather than new ontology row.
An everyday-word interpretation is speculative and does not define an independent observed behavior or settle philosophical agency.

limitations: Three linked attribution facets,not three new intrinsic AI faculties or independent sources. No automatic harm/principle edges,forced citation quota,invented annual counts or full-paper Markdown.
